iflytek-hyper-tts 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Adds support for high-fidelity, human-like speech synthesis (TTS) using the iFlytek Hyper TTS API.
- Allows text-to-speech conversion with controls for speaker, speed, pitch, volume, and output format.
- Includes a curated pool of 7 default voices covering Mandarin (male/female), English (US), and regional Chinese dialects.
- Supports MP3 output (default) and offers parameterized command-line usage.
- Comprehensive documentation covering usage scenarios, input/output parameters, error handling, and environment setup.
